verdicts.reason: Both shrink the elements to the same small size on a much taller canvas and do not lay them out again. The headline is tiny against large empty purple areas above and below, it sits about 10px lower than the Shop pill's centre line, and it floats at an arbitrary left inset while the button hugs the right edge, which unbalances the layout. B is slightly worse: its headline is pushed even further in (about 180px from the left versus about 30px of right margin), which adds dead space on the left, and it gains little for its slightly larger text.
